title: On the Third Hand

moves: In long lines, go forward and back

notes: Written to be a simple dance with a robins left hand chain.

Inspired in part by  "On the Other Hand (It Works Well With Music)" by Abigail Golden and Qwilleran Chapin Duvall. That dance was inspired by Lindsey Dono's request for more simple dances with Robins LH chains.
